# First, reset grid by clicking green block to turn it gray, then click purple dots
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 50, 'col': 30}])
print("After clicking green block:")
print("Board changed:", result['board_changed'])

# Now click purple dot to reset
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 55, 'col': 15}])
print("\nAfter clicking purple dot:")
print("Board changed:", result['board_changed'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("\nRight grid blocks:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 9:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        if min(rows) >= 47:
            r, c = (min(rows)+max(rows))//2, (min(cols)+max(cols))//2
            print(f"  color={n['color']}, center=({r},{c})")

# Now change bar state with DOWN
result = action(['DOWN'])
print("\nAfter DOWN:")
print("Board changed:", result['board_changed'])

# Check bar state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("\nBar parts:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['S', 'b'] and n['pixels'] <= 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        if min(rows) < 30:
            r, c = (min(rows)+max(rows))//2, (min(cols)+max(cols))//2
            print(f"  color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, center=({r},{c})")

# Now click a white block and see what color it turns to
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 50, 'col': 30}])
print("\nAfter clicking white block with bar DOWN:")
print("Board changed:", result['board_changed'])

        if min(rows) >= 47:

            print(f"  color={n['color']}, center=({r},{c})")
